context: Asuka lectures on standards and measurement.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: lecture; abstract vocabulary (基準/最大/相当/新た) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 測るには、明確な基準が要ります。
lines.en: To measure, you need a clear standard.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 基準は、誰が決めるんですか?
lines.style: engaged young student voice, soft warm curious attentive throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 研究者が、新たな基準を提案します。
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 最大の課題は、何でしょうか?
lines.style: thoughtful young student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 最大の課題は、公平さを保つことです。
lines.en: The biggest challenge is keeping fairness.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 相当な議論が、必要そうですね。
lines.en: It seems considerable debate is needed.
lines.style: understanding young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、相当な時間をかけて決めます。
lines.en: Yes, it's decided over considerable time.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: これらの基準が、社会を支えるんですね。
lines.style: moved young student voice, soft warm realization throughout
